description: This source file defines a service for an Android widget that displays upcoming leave events, including a factory class for creating widget views, managing event data, and customizing appearance based on leave type.

classes.name: CalendarWidgetService
classes.description: An Android RemoteViewsService that provides a factory for widget item views displaying leave events.

classes.name: CalendarWidgetFactory
classes.description: A factory class implementing RemoteViewsFactory to supply and manage the list of leave events shown in the widget.

methods.name: onGetViewFactory
methods.description: Returns an instance of CalendarWidgetFactory to create and provide widget views.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initial setup for the widget factory, currently empty placeholder.

methods.name: onDataSetChanged
methods.description: Fetches and filters leave events within the next 7 days based on current date.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Clears the events list for cleanup.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of leave events to display.

methods.name: getViewAt
methods.description: Creates and configures the RemoteViews for each event, avoiding out-of-bounds access, and customizing icon and color based on leave type.

methods.name: getLoadingView
methods.description: Provides a loading view; returns null for default.

methods.name: getViewTypeCount
methods.description: Returns the number of different view types; always 1 here.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a stable ID based on position.

methods.name: hasStableIds
methods.description: Indicates whether item IDs are stable; true here.
